incident-bot: Incident 2001: Increased 5xxs from hosted inference tier. Paging oncall Mira. Please acknowledge.
Mira (oncall): acknowledged. seeing spike in 5xx across region-us-east-1, start ~2001256700. looks like bursty traffic to embeddings and chat endpoints.
Sam (CS): customers A & B reported errors in prod. CS has started triage with them, holding logs.
Robert (infra): I'm seeing backend queue saturation on pool-gpu-4, kernel OOMs and retry storms.
Alex (runtime): pattern: lots of concurrent small requests (avg tokens 12). KV cache hit low, batching not effective. Some clients hammering without backoff.
Mira (oncall): immediate mitigations: we need to reduce incoming pressure + protect platform. propose temporary per-api-key rate-limit and reduce global per-minute caps, and disable non-essential realtime features.
Ryan (sdk): flagging that many customers use our SDK default retry=0 now; we pushed retry guidance earlier but not enforced. We can push an advisory and a short SDK patch to add exponential backoff default.
Mira (oncall): ok do both. Action list: 1) infra: apply soft rate-limit cap to hosted API for non-enterprise tokens (limit 60->10 r/min) 2) runtime: enable traffic shaping to prefer chat over embeddings 3) product: disable streaming-attachments feature flag in hosted for now 4) sdk: publish mitigation snippet and quick patch to default backoff 5) CS: notify impacted customers and provide temporary quota bump options if they comply with idempotency keys.
Robert (infra): issuing rate-limit roll patch now to edge gateway:
```
# temporary rate-limit override
route: /v1/*
match: api_key_tier != "enterprise"
limit: 10/minute
window: 60s
reason: emergency-2001
```
Applying to us-east-1 first. Will monitor.
Robert (infra): patch applied to us-east-1. 2 nodes rolled. Error rate down 30% but still high on embeddings.
Alex (runtime): enabling request steering: embeddings -> lower-priority queue, degrade to quantized-small model variant on overload. toggling now.
Alex (runtime): steering in place. embeddings now hit quantized-small fallback; latency increases slightly but fewer OOMs.
Mira (oncall): Sam, please tell the CS team to ask customers to attach idempotency-key header for retry safety and suggest exponential backoff.
Sam (CS): sending templated note to affected customers now. Example language included.
Ryan (sdk): quick mitigation SDK patch (v1.2.4) ready to publish: set default retries=3 with exponential backoff + jitter and auto-add idempotency-key header for POST/generate calls when absent. Can we do a hot-patch release to cdn?
Mira (oncall): yes, push to CDN with priority. Also post advisory in status and in-app banner.
Ryan (sdk): publishing patch, will also open a short PR with sample snippet we can paste into CS message. snippet: 
```
// recommended retry
function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }
async function requestWithRetry(fn) {
  let base = 500; // ms
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    try { return await fn(); } catch (e) {
      let jitter = Math.floor(Math.random()*100);
      await sleep(base * Math.pow(2,i) + jitter);
    }
  }
  throw new Error('retry-failed');
}
// idempotency header example
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = idempotencyKey || generateUUID();
```
Ryan (sdk): publishing now -> cdn edge invalidation in 30s.
devops-bot: cdn invalidation job queued (job id cdn-200125-7).
devops-bot: cdn invalidation completed.
Mira (oncall): good. Also runtime: can we add soft 429s before hard-tier throttle so clients see backoff signals instead of abrupt 5xx?
Alex (runtime): yes toggled 429-before-throttle. That should encourage polite clients to back off.
Alex (runtime): switching off noncritical feature flag streaming-attachments in hosted.
Robert (infra): monitoring shows error rate halved after rate limits + steering + SDK patch. CPU/mem usage on gpu-pool stabilized.
Mira (oncall): note for next oncall: we did emergency soft rate-limits for non-enterprise tiers, steered embeddings to quantized fallback, disabled streaming-attachments, pushed SDK patch to default retries/idempotency, asked CS to notify customers and offer temporary quota adjustments if they follow idempotency.
Mira (oncall): please add a handoff bullet list for the person taking over in 2 hours.
Alex (runtime): handoff: verify that 429-before-throttle still returns for clients; check steering queue length (target < 200). If regress, revert steering and open new incident.
Robert (infra): handoff: watch edge gateway error rate and token buckets, keep emergency override limit in place until 2h after stabilization. If stable for 2h, we can slowly relax to 30/minute.
Ryan (sdk): handoff: ensure the SDK patch telemetry shows adoption — track number of installs and percentage of requests now including idempotency-key.
Sam (CS): handoff: follow up with A & B in 30m to confirm they're back to normal and remove temporary quotas when appropriate.
Mira (oncall): thanks all. summary for status page and postmortem starter: cause = unbounded client retry storms + small request fanout => queue blowups; mitigations = emergency rate-limits, traffic steering, disable feature, SDK retry defaults, idempotency guidance. action items: (1) enforce SDK backoff in next major release (2) roll permanent soft 429 behavior on gateways (3) create automated detector for small-token fanout spikes (4) add per-key early throttles based on recent qps over window. Owners assigned in thread.
Sam (CS): noted. I'll paste customer messages to the incident archive.
Mira (oncall): handing off to Robert in 2h. tagging @Robert.
Robert (infra): acknowledged, will take over at 2001257650.
incident-bot: Incident 2001 acknowledged by Mira. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.
Mira (oncall): closing this notification thread but keeping incident doc live. will update postmortem after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
